out.editorText: Elmalyn Perez Tejero Elmalyn, totally fair to ask both — the price and where it was done matter a lot before you decide anything. What I've learned watching these journeys is that two people can pay very different amounts for the same word 'rhinoplasty', because it comes down to what's actually being built underneath, not just the shape on top. If you were thinking about it for yourself, what's the one thing you'd want changed first — the bridge, or the tip?
